description: This file implements version management functions for the prplMesh project, including retrieving, converting, and printing version information, as well as handling version query commands.

classes.name: version
classes.description: Class managing version information and related functions within the beerocks namespace.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Constructor initializing version object with version string, build date, and revision.

methods.name: get_module_version
methods.description: Returns the current module version string.

methods.name: get_module_timestamp
methods.description: Returns the build timestamp of the current module.

methods.name: get_module_revision
methods.description: Returns the revision string of the current module.

methods.name: version_to_string
methods.description: Converts a binary version structure to a string representation.

methods.name: version_from_string
methods.description: Parses a version string into a binary version structure.

methods.name: print_version
methods.description: Prints version information to standard output.

methods.name: log_version
methods.description: Logs version information using the logging framework.

methods.name: handle_version_query
methods.description: Handles command-line arguments to display version info based on flags.
